name: stata-csdid181
description: Baseline: Stata csdid 1.82 with drdid 1.91 via pystata for the task's csdid181-rule workloads (method, notyet, long2 for the universal base with the event window moved one period on the pre-treatment side to offset 1.82's long2 event pairing, pscoretrim; one estimation for the estimates and influence-function SEs, saving the RIFs with saverif(); with multipliers, csdid_stats attgt/simple/group/calendar/event with wboot(reps(B) wbtype(rademacher)) for the bootstrap with Stata's own multipliers).
